text:
ana: Quick heads-up — deploybot just attempted an automatic unpin of runtime v2.16 in the night-change window and flagged a compatibility mismatch with SDK 3.4.4. Thoughts? :warning:

deploybot: [automated] attempted action: unpin runtime:v2.16 -> result: blocked (compat-check failed). See error: "sdk-client mismatch: 3.4.x required, found 3.3.x on a subset of canaries"

tj: which canaries are reporting 3.3.x? I thought the SDK rollout finished yesterday.

lucy: eu-west-1 canary pool still has the old SDK image — ops applied an emergency tag last night for slow warmup.

pranay: we intentionally held a small fraction due to a perf regression. Are we comfortable unpinning runtime if some canaries still have 3.3.x?

ana: not without a fallback. If we unpin runtime across the board while SDKs are mixed we risk request panics. My recommendation: keep the pin for 6h and force a targeted SDK patch to those canaries.

lucy: agreed. Proposed plan: 1) keep runtime pin active for next 6h (extend pin window via deploybot) 2) ops to patch eu-west canaries with SDK 3.4.4 image 3) after +1h of green telemetry, re-run compat-check and unpin if clean.

pranay: +1 on that. Also add a rollback snippet in case we see 5xx spike: 
```
# rollback snippet
deploybot rollback runtime:v2.16 --to v2.15 --scope=canary,euwest --reason="sdk-mismatch"
```

tj: can opsrun do the patch now or should we wait for pager handover? It's 02:35 local.

lucy: opsbot, can you confirm whether the patch can be applied without oncall?

opsbot: scheduled maintenance window: night-change (00:00-04:00) — ops can apply a non-breaking image swap. Patch ETA: 20m. Will post status.

deploybot: pin extended: runtime:v2.16 -> PIN ACTIVE (until 1735060989) by ana. Compatibility gate remains closed.

ana: thanks. Can someone add a short note to release notes that runtime v2.16 remains pinned pending SDK parity to avoid confusion for customers watching release feed?

pranay: I'll add a line under "Known rollout notes" and include the exact pin window and planned unpin criteria.

lucy: opsbot reports patch complete on 02:55. Rolling a tiny smoke on 5 canaries now.

opsbot: smoke results: 5/5 green, no errors, latency within baseline.

ana: oks — re-running compat check now.

deploybot: compat-check: PASS (all canaries report SDK >= 3.4.4). Ready to unpin on approval.

ana: approve unpin. Proceed but keep automatic rollback hook enabled for 30m. :+1: 

deploybot: action: unpin runtime:v2.16 -> UNPIN SCHEDULED (rolling in 2m). rollback-hook: enabled (30m)

lucy: monitoring dashboards and will call it out in #incidents if anything unusual.

pranay: noted. I'll watch errors and tokenized latency. If >1% 5xx in 5m window, execute rollback snippet above.

deploybot: unpin complete. runtime:v2.16 is unpinned across hosted and dedicated cohorts.

ana: nice. postmortem not needed — this was planned and telemetry looked healthy. I'll update the release notes now with: "Unpin of runtime v2.16 delayed during night-change window due to SDK canary mismatch; unpin completed after targeted SDK patch and smoke validation."

lucy: :thumbsup:

pranay: closing thread. Thanks all.
